title: steironema quadriflorum

It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are believed to aid in wound healing and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Steironema quadriflorum include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and their effects.
